children: China financing guarantee provider's H1 revenue fell 18.5% yr/yr to RMB115.35 mln
Profit before tax dropped 44.9% yr/yr to RMB20.60 mln
Profit attributable to shareholders declined 74.5% yr/yr to RMB5.29 mln
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods in the press release
GUARANTEE BUSINESS CONTRACTION – Net guarantee fee income fell 27.1% as outstanding guarantees declined, underwriting standards tightened and deferred fees from prior projects decreased
LOWER LENDING INCOME – Net interest income fell 11.9%, as lower entrusted-loan balances, factoring income and bank-deposit balances outweighed stable micro-lending income
